tarot_question_placeholder: Hold a question in mind, or type it here
tarot_templates_hint: Tap a question to use it, then shuffle.
tarot_cut_prompt: Tap anywhere in the spread to cut the deck. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to cut.
tarot_flip_prompt: Tap the cards to reveal them.
tarot_shared_note: This is a shared reading. The cards below were drawn by the person who sent the link.
tarot_shared_invalid: This shared reading link is incomplete, so a new deck is ready instead.
tarot_basis: Every card has one fixed answer for its upright position and one for its reversed position, published in our card list. The answer comes only from that mapping and the card you drew; it is a prompt for reflection, not a factual or predictive answer.
tarot_not_ask_intro: Tarot works best with open questions about your own choices. Avoid these three kinds:
tarot_not_ask_1: Exact names, numbers or dates, such as lottery numbers or the day something will happen.
tarot_not_ask_2: Absolute yes/no about other people's choices, such as whether someone will come back.
tarot_not_ask_3: Health or medical questions — please see a qualified professional.
tarot_three_card_intro: Past, present and future: a quick spread for questions about a situation you are in the middle of. Hold your question in mind, shuffle, cut the deck and reveal each card.
tarot_three_card_template_1: What should I understand about my career right now?
tarot_three_card_template_2: What should I focus on in love?
tarot_three_card_template_3: What am I not seeing in this situation?
tarot_three_card_template_4: How has my past shaped this decision?
tarot_three_card_template_5: What would help me move forward with this project?
tarot_three_card_template_6: What can I learn from this friendship?
tarot_three_card_faq_1_q: How does a three-card tarot reading work?
tarot_three_card_faq_1_a: You shuffle the 78-card deck, cut it where you like, and the top three cards are laid out as past, present and future. Each card's keywords suggest a theme for that part of your question.
tarot_three_card_faq_2_a: Yes. The deck is shuffled in your browser with a cryptographically secure random number generator, every card can appear reversed half of the time, and no card can appear twice in one reading.
tarot_three_card_faq_3_q: Does the future card predict what will happen?
tarot_three_card_faq_3_a: No. The future position describes a direction worth considering. Tarot here is for entertainment and reflection only and does not predict events.
tarot_daily_intro: One card as a theme to reflect on today. Good for a short morning check-in or a question about how to approach the day ahead.
tarot_daily_template_1: What should I keep in mind today?
tarot_daily_template_2: How can I take care of myself today?
tarot_daily_template_3: What energy can I bring to work today?
tarot_daily_template_4: What deserves my attention in my relationships today?
tarot_daily_template_5: What can I let go of today?
tarot_daily_template_6: Where could I find a small win today?
tarot_daily_faq_1_q: Can I draw more than one card a day?
tarot_daily_faq_1_a: You can shuffle again at any time, but many people keep the first card as the day's theme and return to it in the evening.
tarot_daily_faq_2_q: What does a reversed daily card mean?
tarot_daily_faq_2_a: A reversed card points to the same theme from another angle — something blocked, delayed or turned inward. Turn off reversed cards if you prefer upright-only readings.
tarot_daily_faq_3_q: Is the card of the day a forecast?
tarot_daily_faq_3_a: No. It is a prompt for reflection and is not a prediction of what will happen today.
tarot_yes_or_no_intro: One card answers Yes, No or Maybe from a fixed card mapping. Best for simple questions about your own next step.
tarot_yes_or_no_template_1: Should I apply for this job?
tarot_yes_or_no_template_2: Is now a good time to start my project?
tarot_yes_or_no_template_4: Am I ready to make this change?
tarot_yes_or_no_template_5: Should I say yes to this invitation?
tarot_yes_or_no_template_6: Is it worth taking this course?
tarot_yes_or_no_faq_1_q: How is Yes, No or Maybe decided?
tarot_yes_or_no_faq_1_a: Each of the 78 cards has a fixed answer for upright and for reversed. The page shows the answer from that mapping together with the reason for it.
tarot_yes_or_no_faq_2_q: What should I do with a Maybe?
tarot_yes_or_no_faq_2_a: Maybe suggests the question depends on things still open. Try rephrasing it around your own choice, or use the three-card spread to look at it in more detail.
tarot_yes_or_no_faq_3_q: Can I rely on the answer for important decisions?
tarot_yes_or_no_faq_3_a: No. The answer is for entertainment and reflection only. For legal, financial or health decisions, please talk to a qualified professional.
tarot_celtic_cross_intro: The classic ten-card spread for exploring one situation in depth: the core, the challenge, what lies beneath, your approach and the setting around you.
tarot_celtic_cross_template_1: What is really going on in my relationship?
tarot_celtic_cross_template_2: How can I approach this career change?
tarot_celtic_cross_template_3: What is holding me back from moving forward?
tarot_celtic_cross_template_4: What should I understand before making this decision?
tarot_celtic_cross_template_5: How can I grow through this difficult period?
tarot_celtic_cross_template_6: What does this new chapter ask of me?
tarot_celtic_cross_faq_1_q: How do I read the Celtic Cross?
tarot_celtic_cross_faq_1_a: Start with the first two cards — the situation and the challenge across it — then read the cross around them and finish with the staff of four cards on the right. Each position is explained below the spread.
tarot_celtic_cross_faq_2_q: How long does a Celtic Cross reading take?
tarot_celtic_cross_faq_2_a: Revealing the cards takes a minute; reflecting on all ten usually takes ten to fifteen minutes. Use "Reveal all" if you want to see every card at once.
tarot_celtic_cross_faq_3_a: No. All ten cards come from one shuffled deck of 78, so each card appears at most once.
tarot_meaning_try_intro: Draw a card, then turn it over and explore its meaning.
